description: This Java class implements a serial port reader that listens for serial port events, reads incoming bytes, converts them to a string, and passes the data to a DataListener.

classes.name: SerialPortReader
classes.description: A class that listens for serial port events and reads incoming data, forwarding it to a DataListener.

methods.name: SerialPortReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SerialPortReader with a serial port and a data listener.

methods.name: serialEvent
methods.description: Handles serial port events; if data is received, reads bytes and forwards the string to the listener.

methods.name: handleRx
methods.description: Reads incoming bytes from the serial port when data is available and notifies the listener with the received string.
